newsitem.title: FRANCE: Analysts positive on Suez dividend.
newsitem.headline: Analysts positive on Suez dividend.

text.p: Financial analysts said that on first impressions they welcomed the dividend payment of 24.60 francs per share by Cie de Suez prior to its merger with Lyonnaise des Eaux.
"It's rather good news. It leaves about three billion franc in cash in Suez," said Jean-Baptiste Bellon of Deutsche Bank.
Analysts say that the merger will give Suez a better future than its recent past performance while Lyonnaise will get the financial means to bolster its activities.

"Suez saves its skin and Lyonnaise secures the financing of its long-term strategy," said Romain Burnand of Paribas, adding "The new group will be far more independent from pressure from big shareholders,"
